verdict.rationale: Stripe documents official first-party SDKs aimed at AI-native builders. The stripe/ai repo is described as 'a collection of SDKs' and includes @stripe/ai-sdk for Vercel AI SDK, @stripe/token-meter for OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, and @stripe/agent-toolkit (v0.9.0) for LangChain and other frameworks. The MPP docs also install the official `stripe` package alongside the `mppx` SDK, and Stripe publishes OpenAPI files for client generation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the core general-purpose server SDKs across languages (only implied via `npm install stripe` and llms.txt package guidance), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
